structuredContent.body: This PR "reverse builds on" https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/25560 by carving out the parts that should be uncontroversial/purely descriptive of the current role of maintainership, while allowing #25560 to focus on the more aspirational parts (as suggested by instagibbs). Please be sure to cross reference for comments/discussion on #25560.
